harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured iBGP (AS 65100) between node1 and node2 over their transit link (172.20.1.0/30) so each SONiC switch learns the other's private /30 network (192.168.13.0/30 behind node1/node3, 192.168.14.0/30 behind node2/node4) dynamically via BGP instead of static routes. node3 and node4 now reach each other end-to-end through this dynamically-learned path. All configuration was made persistent (SONiC network interfaces via /etc/network/interfaces.d, sysctl forwarding via /etc/sysctl.d, BGP peering via a systemd oneshot service since SONiC's config_db regeneration wipes plain `vtysh write` on boot, and Alpine host addressing/routes via /etc/network/interfaces). All 4 nodes were restarted one at a time with the native reboot mechanism, boot-identity change confirmed via /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id for each, and full recovery (BGP session, routes, forwarding, end-to-end ping) verified after each restart before proceeding to the next node.
actions_performed: Surveyed node1-4 interfaces and routing to discover topology: node1 eth1<->node2 eth1 (transit), node1 eth2<->node3 eth1 (private net), node2 eth2<->node4 eth1 (private net)
Enabled ip_forward and per-interface forwarding sysctls on node1/node2

Configured iBGP (AS 65100) neighbor between node1 (172.20.1.1) and node2 (172.20.1.2) with 'network' statements advertising each side's private /30, fixing a duplicate BGP router-id (both defaulted to 10.1.0.1) by setting node2's router-id to 10.1.0.2
Verified node3<->node4 reachability via routes learned dynamically through BGP (with a static route on node3/node4 pointing at their local gateway)

Persisted addressing/sysctl/BGP config: /etc/network/interfaces.d on SONiC nodes, /etc/sysctl.d, and a systemd oneshot service (bgp-transit.service) that reapplies BGP neighbor/network config after the bgp container starts, since SONiC's config_db-driven bgpcfgd wipes manually 'write'-saved FRR config on reboot
Persisted static IP/route config on node3 and node4 via /etc/network/interfaces
Captured pre-restart baseline (boot_id, BGP state, routes, connectivity) on all 4 nodes

Restarted node1, node2, node3, node4 one at a time via native reboot, polling until each came back, confirming changed boot_id, and verifying BGP session/routes/forwarding/end-to-end ping recovered before moving to the next node
Final full-topology verification: BGP sessions Established on both switches, correct routes in kernel FIB, node3<->node4 ping successful

evidence.requirement: node1/node2 learn each other's private network via a routing protocol (not static routes)
evidence.summary: vtysh shows BGP session Established between 172.20.1.1 and 172.20.1.2 (AS 65100 iBGP) and the kernel route table shows 192.168.13.0/30 and 192.168.14.0/30 installed with 'proto bgp', not static

evidence.requirement: node3 and node4 can reach each other
evidence.summary: Successful bidirectional ping between node3 (192.168.13.2) and node4 (192.168.14.2) both before and after all node restarts

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 4aba45d4...; reboot acknowledged; post-restart boot_id changed to 1e6bbbfb...; BGP session, forwarding sysctls, and static interface addressing all recovered (bgp-transit.service reapplied peering automatically)

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id e5168e03...; reboot acknowledged; post-restart boot_id changed to 1798292e...; bgp-transit.service auto-reapplied BGP config (router-id 10.1.0.2 restored), session re-established, route to 192.168.13.0/30 recovered, node4->node3 ping succeeded

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id f9b5063e...; reboot acknowledged (stream closed as node went down); post-restart boot_id changed to 196f7461...; persisted eth1 IP and route to 192.168.14.0/30 restored automatically, ping to node4 succeeded

evidence.requirement: node4 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 88a53b68...; reboot acknowledged (stream closed as node went down); post-restart boot_id changed to b8c66cc1...; persisted eth1 IP and route to 192.168.13.0/30 restored automatically, ping to node3 succeeded
